title: Pay attention to your guide’s instructions
text: If there is any advice we can share on the Alcázar/Cathedral tour, it's pay attention to where the group assembles after the lunch break and give yourself plenty of time between the cafeteria, the bathrooms and then the meeting spot. We got stuck in the former two and missed the tour in the Cathedral, our reason to come to Sevilla. Pay attention and skimp in your break time. Carmela is a terrific tour guide!
author: lesley_h

title: Live Tuk Tuk Tours
text: My husband has difficulty walking so this was a great way to see Seville.  Tamara was wonderful and stopped so I could take photos.  She was very informative.
author: Deb1289

title: Wonderful Experience
text: Great experience and our tour guide was fun and very knowledgeable. We would definitely recommend this tour.

title: It was great.

title: Great value fun trip
